question: (c) A copper ball of density 8900 kg/m³ weighs 50 N in air. Calculate its weight when it is totally immersed in methylated spirit of density 800 kg/m³. [g = 9.8 m/s²]
modelAnswer:
Mass = W/g = 50/9.8 = 5.102 kg.
Volume = m/ρ_copper = 5.102/8900 = 5.733 × 10⁻⁴ m³.

Upthrust = ρ_spirit × V × g = 800 × 5.733×10⁻⁴ × 9.8 = 4.494 N.

Apparent weight = 50 - 4.494 = 45.5 N.

question:
(b) (i) State Boyle's law and express its mathematical relations.
(ii) A gas contained in a cylinder is of volume 1.0 × 10⁻² m³ at temperature 325 K and pressure 2.7 × 10⁵ N/m². When some of the gas is used at constant temperature, the pressure falls to 1.2 × 10⁵ N/m². Calculate the number of moles of the gas used. (Take R = 8.3 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹)
modelAnswer:
(i) Boyle's Law: At constant temperature, pressure is inversely proportional to volume. PV = constant.

(ii) n₁ = P₁V/(RT) = (2.7×10⁵ × 1.0×10⁻²)/(8.3 × 325) = 1.00 mol.
n₂ = P₂V/(RT) = (1.2×10⁵ × 1.0×10⁻²)/(8.3 × 325) = 0.445 mol.

Moles used = 1.00 - 0.445 = 0.56 mol.

(c) Calculate the electric field intensity and electric potential due to a positive charge of 5.2 × 10⁻⁹ C at a point 20 cm away.
modelAnswer:
(a)(i) Electric Field Intensity: Force per unit positive charge. E = F/q₀. Unit: N/C.
(ii) Electric Potential: Work done per unit charge in bringing a test charge from infinity. V = W/q₀. Unit: Volt.

(b)(i) Φ_E = ∮E·dA = Q_enclosed/ε₀.
Φ_E = total electric flux, E = electric field, dA = area element, Q_enclosed = enclosed charge, ε₀ = permittivity of free space.

(ii) Total flux = Q/ε₀ = (50×10⁻⁶)/(8.85×10⁻¹²) = 5.65 × 10⁶ N·m²/C.
Flux through each face = 5.65×10⁶/6 = 9.42 × 10⁵ N·m²/C.

(c) E = kq/r² = (9×10⁹ × 5.2×10⁻⁹)/(0.20)² = 1170 N/C.
V = kq/r = (9×10⁹ × 5.2×10⁻⁹)/0.20 = 234 V.

question: (c) A metallic surface has a work function of 5.0 × 10⁻¹⁶ eV. Calculate the frequency of the photon whose energy is required to eject electron with a kinetic energy of 5.5 × 10⁻¹⁶ eV.
modelAnswer:
E_photon = φ + KE = 5.0×10⁻¹⁶ + 5.5×10⁻¹⁶ = 10.5 × 10⁻¹⁶ eV.

E = 10.5×10⁻¹⁶ × 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ = 1.682 × 10⁻³⁴ J.
